remarks: Welcome to the most charming and delightful home in Old Hill! Beautiful 6 Hilly Field Lane has been lovingly renovated & is waiting for you. Set on a peaceful cul-de-sac that's perfect for any walk, bike or ride. Less than 6 minutes to downtown Westport and the train and Less than 10 minutes to Compo beach- you'll have easy access to everything. The spacious, flat backyard features a stunning saltwater pool and in-ground stone fire pit with just over an acre of land to relax, entertain & enjoy while taking in the endless skies. Inside, the beautiful design choices & thoughtfulness are evident throughout. The renovated kitchen is complete with a cozy banquette flowing effortlessly into living & family rooms, perfect for all occasions & gatherings. (It's all here- SubZero fridge to gorgeous Quartz counters that sparkle along with sun splashed spaces.) There's a newly added mudroom with a renovated half bath, along w/ three more newly renovated baths upstairs, including the chic primary ensuite. The walkout lower level, (another full bath!)offers easy pool/yard access. The things that really matter have been done too: Auto Pool Safety Cover & Roof? Yes! Sewer hook-up? Also yes, natural gas & town water too! Skip the doing & just start living. With a gentle hill frontage and expansive yard, this property feels like a retreat- Vermont or New Hampshire? It's right here in Westport! Don't miss this special opportunity to come see this exceptional home!
